extension.summary: Your Pley server's movies, shows and music
extension.description: Browse and play what is on your Pley server: Continue Watching, My List, every library, search and playlists, and ask for movies and shows it doesn't have yet. Pley plays files as they are whenever Kodi can, and converts the rest on the server. Sign in with a code shown on screen, typed on your server's link page.[CR][CR]This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
extension.disclaimer: Pley isn't affiliated with Plex Inc. or Team Kodi.

extension.news:
0.1.6 (2026-11-05) Added:
- Your phone, the web and your other devices control what Kodi plays: play, pause, seek and skip, the next title in Kodi's queue or the next episode, the next or previous track, and channel up and down on Live TV. Remotes list Kodi with your TVs, by the device name it was given in Kodi's settings. Needs a server from the same release. - Your phone, the web and your other devices change the audio and subtitles of what Kodi plays, and see which ones play. A pick is saved for the show or movie, as one made in Kodi's player is. - Your phone, the web and your other devices play things on Kodi: a film, an episode, a show's next episode, music, a playlist or a Live TV channel, in place of what plays. Kodi says which device sent it. - Your phone, the web and your other devices change the quality of a film or episode playing on Kodi: the Quality setting changes, as picking it there does, and the title plays again where it was. They see which quality is picked. A film or episode they send plays with the audio and subtitles picked on its page. - Live TV stopped from another device, or by the server's administrator, says so, with their message. - Stopping a Live TV channel, or Kodi, frees its connection at once, so another channel or device can use it straight away.
Changed:
- Requests: a sign-in from before the app could ask says "Sign in again to ask for movies and shows" without a second line, and its button reads Sign in.
